cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester with iron deficiency anaemia (IDA) and haemoglobin (Hb) levels <10 g/dL were included in the study.
finding: IV FCM administration to pregnant patients with IDA during the third trimester was more effective than oral iron treatment in reducing blood transfusion rates and achieving higher Hb levels at delivery.
followup_time: Until delivery and immediate postpartum period for transfusion requirements
